items.title: Fun fact, between them, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta and Luka Garza combined for 638 offensive rebounds in the 25-26 regular season.
items.author: AdamTaylorNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Fun fact, between them, Mitchell Robinson, Neemias Queta and Luka Garza combined for 638 offensive rebounds in the 25-26 regular season. 

The question is, can Mazzulla find consistent minutes for all 3 guys next season?

items.title: The Celtics know that when they call Luka Garza's number, even if he has been out of the rotation, they can depend on him.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
The Celtics know that when they call Luka Garza's number, even if he has been out of the rotation, they can depend on him.

Garza knows that, even after the most validating season of his career, he's still fighting for his place in the NBA.

As he does so...1/2
